{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ferini team''' was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]]. A teenage [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] was their top racer. Then after an illegal race against [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] got him critically injured and kicked out of both professional swoop racing and the Ferini team, Dengar got even by hiring an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to take out his old team by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
